description: Submission of Public Debt Management Regulations No.02 of 2025, to Parliament for approval
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-11-17 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - As per the provisions of section 16 of the Public Debt Management Act, No.33 of 2024, the Public Debt Management Office has been vested with the power to issue Government Debt Securities. In terms of section 31 of the said Act, the Minister in charge of the subject of Finance has been vested with the powers relating to the appointment of primary dealers and issuance of Regulations regarding the matters connected with them. Accordingly, the Public Debt Management Regulations No.02 of 2025 made aiming to authorize the Public Debt Management Office to directly deal with the Primary Dealers and designated non-dealer bidders in the issuance of Government securities, empower the Public Debt Management Office to evaluate the performance of the Primary Dealers and to issue directions, operational guidelines, have been published through the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No.2459/52 dated 2025‑10‑24. The proposal made by the Hon. President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development, to submit the said Regulations to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.
